title: Access assurance: SSO, RBAC v2, audit pipeline — verification & closure plan
creator: Noah Chen
description: Summary: Consolidate findings from the recent penetration test and internal threat review into a reproducible verification plan covering RBAC v2, SSO/SAML bindings, and audit logging. Deliver a playbook that engineering and security can run to validate fixes, plus automation to prevent regressions. Goals: 1) Close high/critical findings affecting admin and privileged paths; 2) Standardize audit log schema and retention/forwarding; 3) Harden SAML bindings and session management; 4) Provide a repeatable verification checklist and e2e tests for CI; 5) Ensure rollout includes monitoring, alerting, and rollback steps.
acceptance_criteria: All critical/High findings addressed or tracked to a follow-up ticket with mitigations and owners
Audit log schema documented and implemented across admin flows, with example Kibana/Datadog dashboards
SAML assertion replay and binding tests added to security CI with pass/fail gating
RBAC v2 policy gaps closed for admin scopes and emergency access flows documented
Automated smoke tests validating audit-forwarding to our SIEM exist and run in PRs
Playbook published in Confluence and a runbook run once in staging with a post-mortem

implementation_notes: Key mitigations: (1) Add explicit 'aud' and 'recipient' checks in SAML consumer; (2) Enforce RBAC v2 scope checks in gateway and admin services; (3) Emit structured admin-audit events (actor.id, actor.role, action, target, request_id, timestamp_ns); (4) Forward logs to SIEM with signed delivery and retry; (5) Rotate session signing keys and issue short-lived admin tokens; (6) Add CI e2e tests for SSO replay and RBAC delegation edge cases.
